messages.subject: Error with MaAsLin merge_metadata.py
parts:
Hello, I am starting to use MaAsLin, but I am encountering an error right at the first step. I have a filtered OTU file from QIIME with relative abundances, and a mapping file with metadata information (subset of the first, and the second attached).
I run the following command with merge_metadata.py to merge the mapping file and the measurements file into a PCL file to send to MaAsLin:

merge_metadata.py map.txt < measures.txt > out.pcl

But I invariably get the following error, which I have no idea how to debug:

Traceback (most recent call last):
  File "/home/user/Maaslin/exec/merge_metadata.py", line 98, in <module>
    import blist
ImportError: No module named blist

What am I doing wrong here? Many thanks!
